Today!

I decide to make a new plan for the next two months

I'll limit my device use and focus on EN

![ChatGPT Image Aug 24, 2026, 07_12_57 PM.png](attachment:ef033935-5662-4bd9-a723-a3323c71d93b:ChatGPT_Image_Aug_24_2026_07_12_57_PM.png)

Two goals recently need to spend time on :

One is TAFE Skill-trade overseas

The other is finishing A-levels and getting IELTS 6.0 ~7.0 to apply for an overseas undergraduate university

Bro we haven't decided between two paths yet but we know we need to build a solid English base first

so passing IELTS is our key question Miao~

start KET and PET as basic, people like to call it mini IELTS tests

I can finish KET in two months, and PET will take 3~4 months maybe

In this period, I'll either prepare A-level subjects or work toward a TAFE trade, like a Certificate III in Elec

I'm not sure witch subject should I choose ,It's depend on your future abroad college and your  job

I wanna work abroad is Australia

The main reason is that my friend Tang is studying at Monash University

One of Australia’s Group‑of‑Eight universities, which ranks 36th in the QS world rankings.

My choice:

TAFE➡️Electricians 电工 木工 护理 旅游 教资

补充：

TAFE skilled‑trade pathway 👉TAFE 技工出海 / 技工移民路径（海外博主通用说法）

Certificate III 澳洲三级技工证书（电工木工核心证书）

permanent residency = PR 永居、绿卡

TRA Trades Recognition Australia：技工职业评估机构（移民必过）

IELTS 考试:

A类学术:用于申读海外大学

G类 培训：移民  TAFE技校 学徒 工签

再考雅思前要打基础Ket Pet 俗称小雅思，KET我的能力1/2个 月能快速过一遍 ,PET再打打，考大学就6.0~7.0 考电工技工就5.5~6.0

KET learning timeline:

take one unit per day

watching learning lesson & take note on teaching book/separate notebook

read the teaching book/notebook

do the corresponding unit exercise(workbook)

mark the wrong question & find the wrong reason（写上错误是的原因，比如某个语法学习薄弱） review the related part in the textbook

and add the correct rule to the wrong question in my note book

1.redo all weekly question once

2.every day review unit dialogues

3.every day 20 Ket core word add 20 daily practical words matching the unit theme each day

4.every grammar practise

posts.excerpt: 这是 Jerry CMS 本地管理的示例文章。你可以点击右下角进入控制台，新建一篇并发布，它会立刻出现在博客列表里。
posts.markdown:
这是一篇由「Jerry CMS」本地生成的文章。

## 它解决了什么

原来博客内容托管在 Notion，本地无法直接管理。现在内容存到本地 `data/posts.json`，**双击启动即可管理**。

## 怎么管理

1. 进入控制台
2. 点「新建文章」
3. 写正文 → 存草稿 / 正式发布

> 支持富文本工具栏、封面图、分类、标签、摘要。

发布后回到 `blog.html` 就能看到这篇。
